posts.name: rickertt
posts.cooked: Played my first game with Ra, Legacy and Wraith against Baron Blade in Insula Primalis. I won, but I wonder if I should admit just barely? The volcanic eruption came out late in the game, after Baron had already flipped. Fortunately I was able to give my two heroes (Legacy lost his HP and was flipped) fire damage immunity and the volcano finished Baron. I hope I did everything right. My wife and I will try the same setup sometime Sunday or Monday. I want to give her Ra, but she might want Wraith as the woman in the threesome. Running 3 heroes for first time was a bit challenging but it was a lot of fun.
